Draw the architecture diagram for the model in this YAML spec as a single standalone SVG file,
following the system instructions exactly.

Before writing, check:
- the layer counts in compressed_view add up to 93
- every zoom panel in the spec has its own data-zoom group
- every callout appears in its own data-callout group, worded exactly as written
- every element is at least 24 px inside the canvas, and nothing overlaps

SPEC:
# Diagram spec: Kimi-K3.1-Pro
# Generated by archwatch.diagram_spec from the published, verifier-approved fields of
# moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro at commit d9e99b0792. No value here comes from an LLM.
# The diagram must use ONLY what is written here. If something is not here, leave it out.

model:
  name: Kimi-K3.1-Pro
  title_label: Kimi-K3.1-Pro (2.8T)
  total_params: 2.78T
  active_params_per_token: 104B
  layers: 93
  hidden_size: 7168
  vocabulary: 163,840 (160K)
  context_length: 1M tokens (1,048,576)
  modality: text + image (vision encoder not shown in the main diagram)
layer_pattern:
  summary: 69 KDA + 24 Gated DSA layers
  rule: Every 4th layer is Gated DSA (layers 4, 8, 12 ... 92), and layer 93 is also Gated DSA. All other layers are KDA.
  compressed_view:
  - repeat: 1
    layers:
    - KDA + dense FFN
    - KDA + LatentMoE
    - KDA + LatentMoE
    - Gated DSA + LatentMoE
    note: layers 1-4
  - repeat: 22
    layers:
    - KDA + LatentMoE
    - KDA + LatentMoE
    - KDA + LatentMoE
    - Gated DSA + LatentMoE
    note: layers 5-92
  - repeat: 1
    layers:
    - Gated DSA + LatentMoE
    note: layer 93
decoder_layer:
- norm (pre-mixer)
- 'Token mixer: KDA or Gated DSA (see zoom panels)'
- Attention residual mix (learned; config attn_res_block_size = 12)
- norm (pre-FFN)
- 'FFN: dense FFN (layer 1) or LatentMoE (layers 2-93)'
- FFN residual mix (learned)
residuals: Residuals are not plain additions. Each layer has learned residual-mixing weights (self_attention_res_proj and mlp_res_proj, plus their norms), and a final output residual mix before the last norm. Show this as a small "AttnRes mix" node on each residual path. Do not invent its internal math.
zoom_panels:
  kda:
    title: Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), 69 layers
    heads: 96 heads x 128 dims
    parts:
    - 'q, k, v projections: Linear 7168 -> 12288 each'
    - short depthwise Conv1d (kernel 4) on q, k and v separately
    - 'beta: Linear 7168 -> 96 (one per head)'
    - 'decay gate: low-rank Linear 7168 -> 128 -> 12288'
    - gated delta rule (fixed 128 x 128 state per head; cache does not grow with context)
    - output norm (per head, 128)
    - 'output gate: Linear 7168 -> 12288, multiplied in'
    - 'output projection: Linear 12288 -> 7168'
    flow: bottom to top, in the order listed
  gated_dsa:
    title: Gated DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), 24 layers
    parts:
    - 'query path: Linear 7168 -> 1536, norm, Linear 1536 -> 96 heads x 192 (128 + 64)'
    - 'KV path: Linear 7168 -> 576 = 512 latent + 64 key dims; norm on the 512 latent; Linear 512 -> 96 heads x (128 key + 128 value)'
    - 'position encoding: NoPE (config mla_use_nope = true)'
    - 'indexer: 32 heads x 128 dims (query from the 1536 latent, key Linear 7168 -> 128 with norm, per-head weights Linear 7168 -> 32)'
    - indexer picks the top 2048 tokens; attention runs only on those
    - 'output gate: Linear 7168 -> 12288, multiplied in'
    - 'output projection: Linear 12288 -> 7168'
    cache_per_token: 576 MLA values + 128 indexer key values per layer
    flow: bottom to top, in the order listed
  dense_ffn:
    title: Dense FFN (layer 1 only)
    parts:
    - 'gate and up: Linear 7168 -> 33792 in parallel; combined by SiTU-GLU; multiply'
    - 'down: Linear 33792 -> 7168'
    flow: bottom to top, in the order listed
  latent_moe:
    title: LatentMoE FFN (layers 2-93)
    parts:
    - 'router: 896 routed experts, sigmoid scores, top 16 per token'
    - 'routed experts work in a smaller latent: 7168 -> 3584 (with norm) -> expert 3072 -> 3584 -> 7168'
    - 2 shared experts (combined width 6144), applied to every token in the full 7168 space
    - 'activation: SiTU-GLU (gated)'
    flow: bottom to top, in the order listed
io:
  bottom:
  - Tokenized text
  - Token embedding 163,840 x 7168
  top:
  - Final AttnRes mix
  - Final norm
  - LM head 7168 -> 163,840 (not tied to the embedding)
  vision: 27-layer vision encoder (401M) + projector (46M) feeds image tokens into the embedding sequence; show as a small side note only
callouts:
- 'Context length: 1M tokens'
- 69 KDA + 24 Gated DSA
- Layer 1 dense FFN; layers 2-93 LatentMoE
- 896 experts, 16 active + 2 shared
- 'KV cache: about 33 KB per token (vs 5.4 MB for plain multi-head attention)'
do_not_include:
- any benchmark scores
- any number not in this file
- logos or watermarks
- the word RoPE
